_note: Canonical NON-SECRET tenant identity for the SENIORS (cawgcap.org) Apps Script project. These map 1:1 to Script Properties consumed by getTenantConfig_() in src/config.gs. Secrets (SA_PRIVATE_KEY, MISSION_WEBHOOK_SECRET, CAPWATCH_AUTHORIZATION) are NOT stored here — see docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.md. This file is repo-only; .claspignore keeps config-tenants/ out of every clasp push.
_xt_note: Cross-tenant contacts (src/cross-tenant-contacts) publishes the CADET roster into this tenant's GAL. XT_PEER_DOMAIN below is the only non-secret cross-tenant value. The peer read-only service-account creds — XT_PEER_SA_EMAIL and XT_PEER_SA_SUBJECT (via setupCrossTenantConfig()) and XT_PEER_SA_KEY (by hand, secret) — are set on the project, NOT stored here. Run validateCrossTenantConfig() to confirm.
_recruiting_address_note: Both addresses below are ROLE GROUPS, so they are version-controlled here and survive a change of incumbent. TENANT_RETENTION_EMAIL addresses the retention run SUMMARY only (as of SendRetentionEmail.gs 1.3.0 it is no longer BCC'd on every member send). TENANT_DIRECTOR_RECRUITING_EMAIL is the replyTo on member-facing retention mail. Both previously read recruiting@cawgcap.org, which does not exist as a group — corrected 2026-07-25 to the ca.dty.director-recruiting group. Verify with a test send before arming the monthly trigger.
_recruiting_mailbox_note: TENANT_RECRUITING_MAILBOX adds a wing recruiting address as a MEMBER of every squadron public-contact group. BLANK DISABLES IT and blank is deliberate: switching it on changes group membership across every unit in the wing. It previously held a literal placeholder in config.gs that was truthy, so each run tried to add that string as a member and failed, per unit, daily. Set it only when the wing decides it wants that fan-in.
_personal_name_note: TENANT_DIRECTOR_RECRUITING_NAME is the incumbent's name as it appears in the signature of member-facing retention email. Unlike the addresses above it names an individual, so it stays BLANK here rather than version-controlled — set it directly in Script Properties on the project, and update it there when the role changes. Blank fields are skipped by setupTenantConfig(), so re-running this never clears an existing value. Blank is valid: retention mail then signs with the office title alone.
